searchText: Generally its this: - have a client that's able to sync mainnet and stably run - get added to ethereum-package/hive and some basic testing tools - be involved in testing and keep up with the fork dev process - have some visible stake on mainnet with the client - reach out to the security team and have them review codebase + organize audit - added to bug bounty program for some duration - added to launchpad its not a strict checklist and depends on the case, but that's the general requirement for being a fully supported mainnet client Thanks <@199561711278227457>, what's launchpad? https://launchpad.ethereum.org/en/

excerpts.content:
Generally its this:
- have a client that's able to sync mainnet and stably run
- get added to ethereum-package/hive and some basic testing tools
- be involved in testing and keep up with the fork dev process
- have some visible stake on mainnet with the client
- reach out to the security team and have them review codebase + organize audit
- added to bug bounty program for some duration
- added to launchpad

its not a strict checklist and depends on the case, but that's the general requirement for being a fully supported mainnet client
